visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit closely on a plush gray couch in a brightly lit indoor room. The woman on the left, with dark hair and a white cardigan, holds a smartphone with a decorated case, while the woman on the right with blonde hair leans in. They make playful poses, including peace signs and heart gestures, while a stuffed animal sits behind them. (2) The setting shifts to a floor where they are surrounded by takeout containers. The dark-haired woman, wearing a thin-strapped top, feeds a spoonful of food to her blonde companion from a large crepe. They both hold these food items in orange wrappers, looking at each other and smiling in a casual, warm atmosphere. (3) Back on the sofa, they hold plastic cups of beverages. The dark-haired woman speaks with an expressive facial expression, gesturing with her free hand as if complaining or telling a story. The blonde woman, holding a dark-colored drink, listens intently with a concerned but supportive gaze in the well-lit living room. (4) From a rear perspective, the two women sit on the floor facing a large television screen. A drama or movie is playing on the screen showing a man's face. They hold chopsticks and bowls, focused on the screen while enjoying their meal in a dimly lit room with a modern entertainment unit. (5) They lie on a white bed, both wearing white facial sheet masks and headbands. They lean their heads together, looking directly at the camera. The dark-haired woman touches the other's cheek playfully. The lighting is soft, emphasizing a relaxed and intimate nighttime skincare routine. (6) In a brightly lit white hallway, both women wear white t-shirts and dark shorts. They dance with high energy, jumping and moving their arms rhythmically in coordination. Their expressions are joyful and exuberant as they perform a synchronized routine for the camera in an open space. (7) They return to the couch, where the dark-haired woman holds a small white cake topped with a single lit candle. They clap their hands together rhythmically, smiling widely and looking at each other. A stuffed toy is visible in the background, completing the warm, celebratory indoor scene.
